title: We Taught Our AI Video Pipeline To Record Its Own Screen
description:
A behind-the-scenes test of the hybrid auto-screen-record + custom scene engine: a real headless-browser recording of a public GitHub repo, framed with Ken Burns motion, alongside a bespoke per-job scene.

Sources: pipeline stress-test render (manual trigger, not a scheduled publish) — exercises the new LiveClipCard component (real Playwright screen capture) and the custom_scenes per-job scene system.
